source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΠΕΝΤΕΚΑΙΔΕΚΑΤΟΣ. Ὅτι χρὴ καθαροὺς καὶ ἐκνενιμμένους παρίστα σθαι τῷ Θεῷ, καὶ ὅτι ἐν Χριστῷ πάλιν ἡμῖν ἡ καθάρσις. Ἐκ παντὸς ἡμῖν, ὦ Παλλάδιε, συναγήγερται λόγου σαφής τε καὶ ἐναργὴς ἀπόδειξις, τοῦ δεῖν ἰέναι
pass_a_gloss: Heading: Concerning the worship and service in Spirit and truth, Book Fifteen. That one must present oneself to God clean and washed out, and that in Christ again is the cleansing for us. Body: Out of every argument/discourse, O Palladius, there has been gathered together for us a clear and vivid demonstration of the necessity to go… [sentence runs on into §2].
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK FIFTEEN. That we must stand before God clean and washed, and that our cleansing, once again, is in Christ.
Cyril: From the whole of our discussion, Palladius, a clear and evident proof has been gathered for us that we must go…
